newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Boral to look at rationalisation.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Boral to look at rationalisation.

text.p: Building materials and energy group Boral Ltd said on Monday it would look at rationalisation either through its own business or through the sharing of joint production facilities with its competitors.

"We are constantly looking at ways that would improve our operations and we will look at all possibilities including rationalisation, either in our control or otherwise," managing director Tony Berg told reporters after the annual meeting.
Last week the Australian Financial Review newspaper reported that fellow building products group CSR Ltd would approach Boral about sharing production facilities.

Berg would not confirm or deny whether he had been in talks with CSR about the possibility of a major restructuring in the building products industry, which is in the midst a price war in a sluggish housing market.
He said any industry rationalisation plan would have to be in the interests of shareholders and be consistent with the Australian anti-monopolies legislation, the Trade Practices Act.
He added Boral was rationalising its own building products operations in Australia, which has reduced the number of manufacturing plants and administration centres.
The Australian Financial Review also reported last week that Pioneer International Ltd would also be part of any talks on industry rationalisation.
